result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a stuck loading spinner obscuring a loaded restaurant image. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontal scrolling and bottom-of-viewport cutoff.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the already-loaded food photo.
issues.suggestion: Hide/remove the loading overlay once the image has loaded, and add a timeout/error state so the spinner does not remain indefinitely over loaded content.
